issues.title: Form editor gets reset on UI refresh
issues.body:
If a user is in a formatted message editor, the editor gets reset each time a new message is received.

Steps to reproduce:
* enter game `Tall Msg`
* login as game admin
* expand` new message` form
*  select `daily intentions` message type
* write `4` as `turn`
* write `have a party` as overall intentions
* put cursor in Game Admin (on right hand side)
* enter `test message`, press send.
* note that different template is now displayed.  When changing back to `Daily intentions` all the text is gone.

Note: we should only close/recreate the JSONEditor if the user no longer has access to that template type.

This should probably be implemented after #893
